name: HSM & Secure Element Assessment
description: Security evaluation of Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), secure elements (SE), Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs), and secure enclaves. Covers logical interface assessment (API abuse, key extraction via protocol flaws), firmware and configuration review, physical tamper protection evaluation, and compliance assessment against FIPS 140-3, Common Criteria, PCI HSM, and GlobalPlatform standards. Detailed TPM and hardware root of trust evaluation belongs to HWSEC-EMBED-TPM, and conformance testing of physical tamper mechanisms against FIPS 140-3 / ISO/IEC 19790 belongs to HWSEC-INV-TAMPER.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to HSM or secure element assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands HSM/SE architectures and relevant security standards
evidence: Can explain the role of HSMs, secure elements, and TPMs in security architectures
Understands FIPS 140-3 security levels and their physical security requirements
Aware of HSM API standards (PKCS#11, GlobalPlatform) and common API abuse patterns

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Assesses HSM/SE configurations and interfaces under supervision
evidence: Reviews HSM/SE configuration for security policy compliance
Tests cryptographic API for known vulnerability patterns (key extraction, role confusion)
Assesses TPM configuration and PCR policy on target platforms with guidance
Documents HSM/SE security architecture and interface attack surface

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evaluates HSM/SE security including both logical and physical aspects
evidence: Performs comprehensive PKCS#11 or proprietary API security assessment
Evaluates tamper protection mechanisms (meshes, sensors, environmental detectors, zeroization response)
Assesses firmware update mechanisms and secure boot on HSM/SE platforms
Completed HSM/SE assessments on 3+ distinct platforms against applicable standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs deep HSM/SE assessments combining logical and physical attacks; mentors team
evidence: Combines API testing with physical attacks (SCA, FI) against HSM/SE targets
Assesses custom secure element applets and JavaCard/GlobalPlatform implementations
Evaluates HSM cluster security including key synchronization and failover mechanisms
Mentors team on HSM/SE assessment methodology and standard compliance evaluation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on HSM/SE security; defines evaluation methodology; contributes to standards
evidence: Defines the lab's HSM/SE evaluation methodology aligned with FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria
Published research on HSM/SE vulnerabilities or evaluation techniques
Provides expert consultation on HSM/SE security architecture to vendors and certification bodies
Contributes to HSM/SE security standards or certification guidelines

assessment_methods.description: Perform a security assessment of an HSM or secure element: evaluate API security, assess tamper protection, and report compliance against a specified standard
Review HSM/SE assessment reports for standard compliance coverage, API testing thoroughness, and physical security evaluation completeness

equipment: Tamper response testing equipment (thermal chamber, voltage stress source)
